```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: Compute HIGH VTE alarm
    Given the VTE for the current breath is above the threshold
    When the GUI computes the VTE
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute LOW VTE alarm
    Given the VTE for the current breath is below the threshold
    When the GUI computes the VTE
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be active
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

  Scenario: Compute VTE for each breath
    Given the GUI is initialized
    When a new breath is detected
    Then the GUI should compute the VTE for that breath

  Scenario: Pressure high alarm does not re-trigger
    Given the "pressure high" alarm is active
    When the alarm is cancelled
    Then the "pressure high" alarm should not re-trigger for 2 minutes

  Scenario: High-priority alarm on O2 input line disconnection
    Given the O2 input line is disconnected
    When the GUI detects the disconnection
    Then a high-priority alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: Display all active alarms
    Given there are multiple active alarms
    When the GUI is requested to display all alarms
    Then all currently active alarms should be displayed

  Scenario: Event log includes confirmed alarm settings
    Given an alarm is confirmed
    When the event log is checked
    Then the confirmed alarm settings should be included in the event log
```
